main_text.p: Ἀντοί, Ἀντῷ, Ἀντοίς, Ἀντοὺς, Ἀντοί. Sic Σαπφῶ, Διδῶ, & in ω plurima. Sic ἡ αἰδὼς pudor, αἰδόος αἰδοῦς, vocativo αἰδοῖ.
In ως duo tantùm sunt, αἰδὼς pudor, & ἠὼς aurora.
Poetæ in plurali dicunt Κλωῆς, Κλωθῶν, Κλωαί, pro Κλωῇσι, Κλωθῶν, Κλωῇς: Clotho.
Contractio ex οις. Secundò est hîc contractio masculinorum imparisyllaborum in nominativo, accusativo, & vocativo pluralibus: quæ accusativum singularem habent in ѵ, & sic flectuntur:

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as best legible; the lower mark "b" is a catchword-like mark, not text. Several Greek accents are uncertain in the scan.
